Transparent by design

What this prototype shows—and what it does not.

01

Frozen analyzed datasets

The portal reads versioned exports and preserves each source object’s UMAP. It does not recluster cells in the browser.

02

Liver-only scope

Spleen reference cells remain in some source objects but are excluded from every version 1 portal product.

03

Expression is descriptive

Gene gradients show normalized RNA expression. They do not represent significance or biological-replicate tests.

04

TCR release is pending

The TCR module spans the T-cell branch, but clone identity and public fields must be frozen before it is enabled.
